ann.t: Outcome of Board Meeting — Mold-Tek Packaging Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026.
Allotment of Securities — Mold-Tek Packaging Limited has informed the Exchange regarding allotment of 33228914 securities pursuant to Bonus issue on October 12, 2026
Record Date — Mold-Tek Packaging Limited has informed the Exchange that Record date for the purpose of Bonus  is 09-Oct-2026.
Press Release — Mold-Tek Packaging Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated August 26, 2026, titled "Press Release for Bonus Issue".

Bonus — Mold-Tek Packaging Limited has informed the Exchange that the Board of Directors at its meeting held on August 26, 2026, have considered and approved bonus at the ratio of 1 : 1, i.e 1 Equity Shares for every 1 Equity Shares held.
Outcome of Board Meeting — Mold-Tek Packaging Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended Jun 30, 2026.
Outcome of Board Meeting — Mold-Tek Packaging Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended March 31, 2026.
Outcome of Board Meeting — Mold-Tek Packaging Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended December 31, 2025.
